overall_assessment: UiS section extraction is unreliable. Many headings that UiS uses (Forkunnskapskrav, Eksamen / vurdering, Åpent for, Emneevaluering, Praksis, Overlapping, Fagperson(er), Kontakt) are not cut as boundaries, so text is merged into the preceding section; metadata headers, staff names and PDF page-break artefacts pollute sections; and in the older 'Vis timeplan' pages, course-description sub-headings starting with 'Litteratur'/'Pensum' are routed into reading_list. Five of 20 suspects have no sections at all. The Vilkår -> coursework_requirements mapping works in most modern HTML plans, and clean modern plans (e.g. MGL3120, LPRA10, MGL410M) extract mostly correctly apart from trailing admin text.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk(e) undervisningsaktivitet(er) som må være bestått
findings.description: learning_outcomes does not stop at the end of the outcomes. It swallows the Forkunnskapskrav text (prerequisites), the 'Eksamen / vurdering' and 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen/vurdering' headings and the obligatory-activity text (coursework_requirements). The result is a prerequisites section that is missing or empty, a polluted learning_outcomes, and coursework text filed under learning outcomes. In LNOR165 the coursework paragraph is split: the 'Presisering av innleveringsoppgåva' part sits in learning_outcomes and its continuation sits in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Forkunnskapskrav', 'Eksamen / vurdering' (with spaces around the slash) and 'Vilkår ...' headings are not detected as section boundaries in these pages (probably not h2 elements, or not matched in the text_split fallback), so the section opened by 'Læringsutbytte' continues until a later recognized heading. See extract_sections_html in R/extract_sections.R and the heading map in R/section_heading_map.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the actual DOM level of these headings and set section_heading_selector/level for uis accordingly (or include h3/.paragraph--with-title titles). In R/section_heading_map.R add exact patterns for 'eksamen / vurdering' (with spaces) -> assessment and verify 'forkunnskapskrav' and 'vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen/vurdering' split in the fallback text_split path as well.

findings.evidence: Emnebeskrivelsen er hentet fra Felles studentsystem Versjon 1
findings.description: Headings with no entry in the heading map (Arbeidsformer in older pages, Åpent for / Åpen for / Ope for, Emneevaluering, Praksis, Overlapping, Fagperson(er), Kontakt) do not start a new section, so their text is appended to whichever section came last. coursework_requirements, assessment and teaching_methods therefore end in admin text (open-for lists, course evaluation boilerplate, 'Emnebeskrivelsen er hentet fra Felles studentsystem'), staff lists and overlap tables. In MREL150 the whole Arbeidsformer block (teaching methods) lands in assessment and no teaching_methods row exists.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R returns NA for unmapped headings and the extractor appends the heading and body to the previous section instead of closing it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add admin-heading patterns (åpent for|åpen for|ope for, emneevaluering, overlapping, kontakt, fagperson) mapped to a drop/ignore marker so that they terminate the current section and their text is discarded; keep 'praksis' as teaching_methods or drop it. Check the older 'Arbeidsformer' variant is mapped to teaching_methods when it follows 'Vilkår ...'.

findings.evidence: Dette kurset vil gi studentene oversikt over 1800-tallslitteratur med særlig fokus på hvordan de utvalgte tekstene kan leses i lys av det "monstrøse".
findings.description: In plans without a real literature list, reading_list contains course-description prose (and trailing 'Læringsutbytte / Kunnskap' labels). Sub-headings inside Innhold/Introduksjon such as 'Litteratur og det monstrøse', 'Litteratur (Litteratur og myte)', 'Litteratur og galskap: ...' and 'Pensum' are mapped to reading_list. The same course then lacks course_content, and the first learning outcome group is cut or has lost its first lines.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Prefix/regex heading matching ('litteratur', 'pensum') in R/section_heading_map.R and/or the text_split fallback treats short in-body title lines as section headings.
findings.suggested_fix: Match reading_list headings only on exact, whole-line headings ('Litteratur', 'Pensum', 'Pensumlitteratur', 'Pensumliste'), not startsWith; require that heading lines come from the structural heading elements, not from paragraph text.

findings.evidence: Kunnskap om betydningen av ulike bevegelsesmiljø for elevenes læring
findings.description: The first item of the Kunnskap group is lost. In MGL4066 'Kunnskap om fagdidaktisk forskning i kroppsøving' is missing; in MGD3400 the first bullet ('har inngående kunnskap om utviklingsprosesser/læring i skolen som organisasjon') ends up in course_content after the stray 'Læringsutbytte / Kunnskap / Studenten' labels; in MGL4300 bullet K2 is missing. The sub-heading labels (Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse) are dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The first paragraph/list item after the Læringsutbytte heading is attributed to the previous section (or consumed as a heading) in extract_sections_html; blank-line-separated list items are lost in cleaning (.clean_sections).
findings.suggested_fix: Start learning_outcomes at the first node after the 'Læringsutbytte' heading node, and do not treat 'Kunnskap', 'Ferdigheter', 'Generell kompetanse', 'Studenten', 'Kandidaten' as boundaries. Diff section text against the plan to confirm all bullets are kept.

findings.description: 5 of 20 suspects have no section rows although the plan has clear Innhold, Læringsutbytte, Forkunnskapskrav, Arbeidsformer and Eksamen / vurdering content (LMLIMAS, MENG165, MPE410). MGL3036 and ENG340 are near-empty plans (only prerequisites and obligatory-activity labels), where nothing real is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The html_headings strategy and its text_split fallback return nothing for plans where headings are not in the expected h2 structure (older 'Vis timeplan' pages with Innhold/Introduksjon).
findings.suggested_fix: Debug extract_sections_html for these course_ids and make the text_split fallback fire when the heading path yields zero rows (headings: Introduksjon, Innhold, Læringsutbytte, Forkunnskapskrav, Arbeidsformer, Eksamen / vurdering). Add a QA assertion that plans with Læringsutbytte text never produce zero sections.

findings.description: The page header block (Emnekode, Vekting, Semester undervisningsstart, Undervisningsspråk, Tilbys av) plus the unheaded introduction paragraph is attached to a real section: assessment in MGL3066/MGL4066, learning_outcomes in MGL4400 and MGL4300, reading_list in MGL2120. It is administrative metadata, and the introduction is not part of those sections. In MGL3066-2023 the title fragment 'kroppsøvingsfaget' is also prepended.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Content before the first recognized heading is not discarded or assigned to course_content; it is attached to a later section when headings are reordered or pre-heading text is flushed into the next section.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop all text before the first mapped heading, or assign the unheaded introduction to course_content. Strip the lines 'Emnekode:', 'Vekting', 'Semester ...', 'Undervisningsspråk:', 'Tilbys av:' in .clean_sections().

findings.description: Staff lists ('Fagperson(er)') with named individuals are included at the end of coursework_requirements in nearly all modern plans, and in reading_list for older ones ('Fagpersoner' in LENG115). This is not requirement text, and it contains personal names that downstream anonymization must deal with.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Fagperson(er)' / 'Fagpersoner' heading is unmapped (see admin-heading finding), so it is appended to the last section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map '^fagperson' to an ignore marker in R/section_heading_map.R so the staff list is discarded at the section stage.

findings.evidence: Nordberg, Nils Håkon, Eriksen, Helle Linné; Hustadbråten, Siri; Nordberg, Nils Håkon, Oslo, Universitetsforlaget, 220
findings.description: Most of the literature list (about 5,700 chars, bibliographic entries and bibsys URLs) is stored in assessment, while reading_list holds only the first entries and ends at a bare 'Bok'. The reading list is split across two sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A line inside the literature list (e.g. a 'Vurdering'/'Eksamen' keyword in an entry or a heading-like line) is matched as an assessment heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Once a reading_list heading has been seen, do not allow switching to other sections except through exact whole-line headings; check which line inside the list triggers the assessment switch and tighten that pattern.

findings.description: Literature entries contain very long Primo/bibsys OpenURL strings (rft.* parameters, user_ip, ctx_tim) that make up most of the reading_list (28-46k chars). They carry no content, and they also include internal IP addresses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Leganto literature export is copied as-is, with no cleaning of link text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or the reading_list cleaner) remove tokens matching 'https://bibsys-ur\.userservices[^\s]*' and the following continuation lines up to 'View online', and remove 'View online' markers.

findings.evidence: ●   Moderne og klassiske tekster innenfor engelskspråklig litteratur fra ulike deler av verden
findings.description: In the PDF-derived plan, the learning outcomes are split. Some bullets are in learning_outcomes (only 360 chars, containing 'side 1' and a heading fragment), and the other bullets are scattered as fragments in reading_list, together with the Fagpersoner list and header metadata. Another 'Åpen for' variant is merged into assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: text_split on PDF-extracted text with page breaks, indented bullets and repeated 'Emne LENG115_1, BOKMÅL...' running headers: lines after a page break are interpreted as new headings.
findings.suggested_fix: Pre-clean PDF text before splitting: remove running headers ('Emne XXX, BOKMÅL, ... versjon'), 'side N' lines, 'Powered by TCPDF', and de-indent lines. Only treat a line as a heading if it exactly equals a known heading string.

findings.evidence: Gjennom semesteret vil studentene få utlevert totalt ti korte skriveoppgaver knyttet til
findings.description: The obligatory-activity text (ten short writing assignments, eight must be approved before the exam) is in assessment, while coursework_requirements contains only the label 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' (22 chars, flagged short). This is a pass/approve gate, which the codebook places in coursework_requirements. The assessment also contains the overlap table and the Åpen for / Emneevaluering text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In the PDF layout the 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen/vurdering' heading is followed by a sub-label; the extractor splits at the sub-label, and the remaining text falls back to assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat the 'Vilkår ...' heading as opening coursework_requirements until the next mapped heading; do not let 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' or 'Obligatoriske krav' sub-labels open a new section.

findings.description: PDF-derived plans (2014-2019) keep page-break artefacts inside sections: 'side N', 'EMNE ... Versjon ... ' running headers, 'Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)', and heavy indentation from the layout. Tables (exam table headers 'Vekt Varighet Karakter Hjelpemidler') are also left as raw columns in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: text_split performs no cleanup of PDF-specific noise in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Add regex removal of '^\s*side \d+\s*$', '^\s*EMNE \S+ .*Versjon.*$', 'Powered by TCPDF.*' and trim leading whitespace per line in .clean_sections().
